title: Phoenix TSMC Fab 3 Topping-Out Record — Phase 65 TSMC Arizona delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the TSMC Arizona delivery reporting pack. Phoenix records installation of the final and highest structural beam on TSMC Fab 3 and relays that initial construction had begun on a fourth fab and the first advanced-packaging plant.
key_findings: The Fab 3 event is a specific physical superstructure milestone.
The page identifies the planned process as 2 nanometer.
Later-facility starts are reported separately from completion or operation.
why_it_matters: Which records separate campus construction, utility arrangements, workforce inputs, qualification, customer acceptance, and repeat facility output? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. The record advances the local semiconductor dossier beyond investment announcements into observable construction while preserving the later equipment, service, occupancy, qualification, and production stages.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a project-level construction event to the Southwest chip corridor.
Increases the relevance of the open power, water, wastewater, labor, and supplier gaps.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
Topping out does not prove building completion, occupancy, tool installation, qualification, or production.
Statements about later facilities, employment, and future output remain City-relayed company or partner claims.
